decision.summary: Two regions warrant closer inspection: (1) a large, abrupt U-axis spike near index 580 with correlated cross-axis responses and incomplete recovery; (2) a sustained multi-axis offset/platform from ~610–635 with coherent N/E/U behavior and no clear return within the window. Other segments show typical noise or smooth motion.

regions.observation: Sharp, multi-sample negative spike in U (downward ~17 MAD) at index ~580–585, with correlated smaller negative excursions in N and E; no clear opposing return within the window, though U begins recovering after 585. The event is abrupt and isolated, distinct from surrounding noise.

Broad apparent platform or slow offset in E (centered ~−4 to −5 MAD) from ~615 to 635, accompanied by a subtle but sustained negative shift in N (~−1 to −2 MAD) and U (~−3 to −4 MAD); all three axes show coherent behavior without immediate reversal, suggesting possible temporary deformation or instrumental bias.
